settings.heading: Original brands, without the boutique mark-up.
settings.lead: HandPicked is a Pakistani store for 100% original international brands. We buy export-surplus and outlet stock, check every piece, and sell it at outlet prices, delivered to your door with cash on delivery.

settings.heading: 100% original
settings.text: Every piece is an original from an international label, sourced as export surplus or outlet stock. Never a replica.

settings.heading: Outlet prices
settings.text: No boutique rent, no middle layers. You pay outlet prices for the same label.

settings.heading: Fair exchange
settings.text: 7-day free size exchange. Refund only if the item is not as described.

settings.question: Are your products really original?
settings.answer: Yes. We sell 100% original international brands, sourced as export-surplus and outlet stock. We never sell replicas or copies.

settings.question: Why are your prices lower than the mall?
settings.answer: Export-surplus and outlet stock is bought in volume and sold without boutique rent or mark-up, so you get the same label for less.

settings.question: Why do some sizes show only one or two pieces left?
settings.answer: Surplus stock is limited. When a size sells out, it usually does not come back, so the stock counts you see are real.

settings.question: How does cash on delivery work?
settings.answer: Place your order, our team confirms it on WhatsApp, and you pay the courier in cash when it arrives. Check the parcel at the door.
